body: From the DM-170 review (orchestrator, this run), relevant when you send real usage: the `ledger.ts` screens (src/core/space/ledger.ts) refuse some legitimate labels, and one refused label fails the whole all-or-none batch: API routes like `/v1/messages` (line ~107, any two-segment leading-slash text is a 'path'), `1 token = 4 chars` / `token:char ratio 1:4` (line ~95), `basic length/4 estimate` (line ~89), `npm_run_build_production_bundle` (line ~90). Fix these screens if your adapters' estimate methods or labels hit them (require a secret-shaped value after `name=`, drop bare `token`, anchor Basic auth to 16+ base64 chars, `npm_` + 36 alphanumerics), and keep the existing refusals. Also: `C:/secret.txt`, `D:/dmwt` are still accepted as non-paths.
